notes: long addition wraps modulo 2^64 (two's complement); Long.toUnsignedString prints the unsigned value.
Lines are batched into ~64 KiB StringBuilder chunks and written as ASCII bytes to a BufferedOutputStream over FileDescriptor.out.
Digits are checked explicitly because Long.parseLong also accepts a leading '+'.
Default JVM flags: startup dominates small N, and the short-lived Strings pile up in G1's young generation, so peak memory reflects default heap sizing rather than live data.
